repeat_aggregation: apply every perturbation to each repeat's held-out predictions and training-derived weights first, then average fused probabilities; never multiply separately averaged probabilities and weights
missingness: independent uniform variate per generated record; nested masks across requested fractions; actual realized counts reported; same masks for all methods
availability_rule: one unavailable modality receives zero weight in BOTH quality-aware and equal baselines; both-unavailable rejected; synthetic missingness does not imply scientific QC validity
probability_shrinkage: p_fMRI becomes (1-level)*p_fMRI+level*0.5; quality-aware fMRI reliability mass multiplied by 1-level then renormalized; mathematical interface perturbation, not signal-noise preprocessing or modality retraining
uncertainty: same 1000 seed/class-stratified paired record bootstrap indices as 03; conditional on frozen averaged held-out predictions; no model-refitting uncertainty
timing_method: perf_counter_ns around one public API invocation; inputs generated outside timed region; single BLAS/OpenMP thread; report median, q25/q75 and min/max; not full-pipeline or method-superiority timing
memory: native peak memory not measured; no peak-memory claim
reporting_policy: retain all ablations and all levels; no retrospective favorable selection; no independent-fold significance test
